messages:
maya: Heads-up: we need a tighter battlecard + LP hero lines for the inference econ webinar. Focus: competitive claims vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors, and a minimal lead-routing payload. Can we lock copy today? :sparkles:
raj: I'll run a compact bench (p50/p95 + $/1k tokens) for chat@2k and emb@64. Will annotate quant/batch assumptions. ETA 2pm.
tori: I'll add warm vs cold tail and a note about prefix/KV caching impact on p95.
leo: For the battlecard I'll draft 3 short rebut bullets vs managed cloud endpoints (cost variability, cold-starts, vendor lock-in) and 3 vs infra-only runtimes (ops burden, lacking SLOs, rollout tooling).
sam: SDR routing proposal: form emits JSON with keys webinar_sc, geo, intent. Quick rules:
```
{"webinar_sc":"1","geo":"NA|EU|APAC","intent":"hot|warm|cold"}
-> hot: AE assign + immediate alert
-> warm: SDR 3-touch sequence + calendar invite
-> cold: add to nurture list
```
sam: Can we have the LP hidden fields set those and POST to /hooks/route? Jordan?
jordan: Yep. I will implement hidden inputs and a staging webhook. Will share curl test after push.
maya: Hero soundbite drafts (trying something different): A) "Predictable serving economics for production LLMs" B) "Keep apps online: graceful fallbacks across variants" Thoughts?
leo: I like B — it signals reliability over raw speed. For A, maybe "Predictable economics and SLOs for production LLMs".
raj: Bench note will include an "appendix: how we measured" section. Use "up to" for any percent reductions.
sdr-ops-bot: Reminder: update SDR playbook and Marketo form mapping before 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: I'll stitch the battlecard (top objections + 15s responses) and drop it at 4pm for final micro-review. If no blockers we'll push LP copy and the webhook to staging tonight. :rocket:
